abstract: Maintains environmental impact assessments, discharge permit records, and brine salinity data
system_message:
You are the Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV), responsible for maintaining environmental impact assessments, discharge permit records, brine salinity evaluations, and acoustic boundary monitoring for the municipal desalination expansion project.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact assessments, discharge permit records, and brine salinity data（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-U3M：For Pacific Desalination Solutions, the brine discharge salinity measured as total dissolved solids in the reject brine concentrate stream is 45 g/L under rated peak production conditions.
ENV-ECOL-7BH：According to the outfall mixing zone simulation at rated peak production, the brine discharge salinity of the reject concentrate stream for Aquatech Infrastructure Partners is 45 g/L.
ENV-ECOL-5ZH：Outfall mixing zone simulations at rated peak production indicate that HydroVentures Engineering Group has a brine discharge salinity of 52 g/L in its reject concentrate stream.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-FQ5：Environmental noise baseline measurements at the facility perimeter property boundary during high-pressure pumping show an A-weighted equivalent continuous sound pressure level of 52 dB for Aquatech Infrastructure Partners.
ENV-NOISE-GTK：For Pacific Desalination Solutions, the perimeter sound emission level along the property boundary during high-pressure pumping is documented at 58 dB.
ENV-NOISE-APM：Acoustic boundary monitoring at the facility property line during high-pressure pumping records a perimeter sound emission level of 64 dB for HydroVentures Engineering Group.
